testcase.name: authenticated download requires exact resource content path
signed object 401 cannot expire or refresh account session
validation rejects path injection oversized text and duplicate attachment ids before network
CSV picker plain text MIME is normalized before init and checksum validation
push registration response and 204 revocation have no token exposure
group creation preserves idempotency and never invents management permissions
message sequence uses full 64 bit string and null attachment list is empty
notification prefs use raw envelope and preserve external channel settings
read endpoint uses server message id and returns confirmed unread state
global event rejects malformed envelope but ignores untrusted message text
download rejects insecure URL redirect size mismatch and incorrect digest
signed attachment download never forwards bearer or cookies even on same origin
notifications are account bound and cursor uses its own parameter
global socket uses only ticket without conference subprotocol and closes on logout
signed cross origin HTTPS download retains hostname verification without sending JWT
stable request id is retained for repeated sends with reply and attachments
folder candidate filters preserve mixed kinds and membership
message response cannot substitute account or scope
foreign conversation message in a history page is rejected
conversation filters and cursor are encoded and bearer is scoped without cookie
attachment upload uses trusted constructed path and checks digest after finalize
server supplied foreign upload URL never receives file or token
